title: Beta report 28/10: imports and live syncs read past PHP notices, call_failed says where, page.look reads its own home page, look.set beats theme.json CSS, confirmation retries explain missing consent, a silent copy is not warming up, the visual check draws without a site browser, the installer stands in a missing collation
steps: S1 (1a): an engine reply with PHP 8.5's curl_close() deprecation printed ahead of its JSON reaches the import, Sync from live and Sync to live.
S2 (1a): an engine call answered by a page, by PHP notices alone, or by the engine's own refusal stops the import.
S3 (2b): the browser, pointed at a site's loopback, is sent to exactly that site's public origin (page.look style, page.text's browser, the customer view).
S4 (3a): look.set scope site on a WordPress block theme whose theme.json styles.css sets the token again on :root.
S5 (2a): retry a destructive call with confirm:true before any customer answer.
S6 (1b): COMPONENT_NOT_ON_FLEET_COPY timeout with transient false reaches the agent.
S7 (2c): the visual check draws a page whose site container has no browser, and a turn with no held write has no before.
S8 (3b): a dump naming utf8mb4_uca1400_* and utf8mb4_0900_* collations is planned against a server that lacks them.
S9 (2a): in Chrome answer two distinct IDs, an identical new call, then answer a re-delivered call whose first answer was lost before host receipt.
S10 (2c): real Chrome captures before/after from a browserless Joomla image with networking disabled, a requested scroll and a page script that attempts to repaint the page.
expect: S1: the reply is read; the export, the live read and the live write finish.
S2: call_failed with diagnostic export/no_engine_reply (status, action, answer kind) or export/engine_refused (engine code, else other); site.stuck keeps it and the alert prints it.
S3: the browser is asked once more as the public origin, served from the container loopback; any other address stays REDIRECTED_OFF_SITE.
S4: the appended selector is :root:not(.\#); a token that is only a theme.json variable keeps :root.
S5: CONFIRM_FIRST, confirmationMissing true, no write, and next explicitly waits for a customer answer to this exact call.
S6: the next says the copy has not answered for a long while, do not retry, it needs checking.
S7: dsh's browser draws the view pinned to the container (via 127.0.0.1:<port>), serving the site's own images and fonts only; the skip reads no-before: not-held.
S8: uca1400 -> utf8mb4_unicode_520_ci, as_cs -> utf8mb4_bin, a known collation unchanged, rows untouched.
S9: every answer carries its own question ID; a new waterfall channel unlocks the same carrier without carrying consent into another call.
S10: both real JPEGs load, preserve the viewport and scroll, and show the red then blue backgrounds; page JavaScript stays disabled.

selectors.exports: engineReply, afterPhpNotices, answerKind, publicRetarget, browseAsSite, captureView host, ti_collation_plan

evidence: tch-internal marketing/strategy/launch/2026-10-16-tong-ket-tuan-beta/loi-can-sua-2026-10-28.md (beta data 23-28/10/2026); php:8.5-cli prints the curl_close() deprecation ahead of the JSON; MariaDB 10.4 and MySQL 8.0 refuse the dumped table with 1273 and create the planned one
fence: Engine reply reader, browser off-site guard, look.set specificity, confirm memory, fleet copy refusal, host-mode view, installer collation plan
